# Base Image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (Jammy Jellyfish)
# This provides a modern, stable base with recent compilers and libraries.
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set environment variables to enable non-interactive installation of packages.
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Set Open MPI environment variables for better performance and compatibility in containerized environments.
# This helps avoid common issues with shared memory (vader) and network interfaces (openib) in Docker/Kubernetes.
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none
ENV OMPI_MCA_rmaps_base_mapping_policy=slot
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl="^openib"

# Install build dependencies, MPI, git for cloning, essential certificates, and Python.
# --no-install-recommends is used to keep the image size smaller.
# The package list is cleaned up in the same layer to reduce final image size.
# FIX: Added python3 to satisfy the LAMMPS cmake dependency.
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    ca-certificates \
    cmake \
    gfortran \
    git \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    openmpi-bin \
    python3 \
    wget && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Clone the latest version of the LAMMPS source code from the official GitHub repository.
# --depth 1 creates a shallow clone, which is faster and smaller as it omits the full history.
# The source is placed in /lammps.
RUN git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/lammps/lammps.git /lammps

# Create a build directory and compile LAMMPS.
# We use CMake to configure the build.
# - CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release: Optimizes the build for performance.
# - BUILD_MPI=yes: Enables MPI support, essential for HPC.
# - PKG_REAXFF=yes: Enables the ReaxFF package as requested for 'lammps-reax'.
# - PKG_KSPACE, PKG_MOLECULE, PKG_RIGID are included as they are common dependencies for many simulations.
# The build is parallelized using all available processor cores with `make -j$(nproc)`.
RUN cd /lammps && \
    mkdir build && \
    cd build && \
    cmake ../cmake \
      -D CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
      -D BUILD_MPI=yes \
      -D PKG_REAXFF=yes \
      -D PKG_KSPACE=yes \
      -D PKG_MOLECULE=yes \
      -D PKG_RIGID=yes && \
    make -j$(nproc)

# Add the LAMMPS build directory to the system PATH.
# This ensures that the 'lmp' executable can be called directly without specifying its full path.
ENV PATH="/lammps/build:${PATH}"

# Set the default working directory for the container.
# This is where users will land when they start the container.
WORKDIR /workspace

# Copy the example files for the HNS ReaxFF simulation into the working directory.
# This provides a ready-to-run example for users of the image.
RUN cp /lammps/examples/reaxff/HNS/* .

# Set a default command to start a bash shell.
# This allows for interactive use and easy debugging. For batch jobs, this command will be overridden.
CMD ["/bin/bash"]
